import hashlib
import json

from subject import HandlerGoldenChainGenerator
from omnibase_core.models.ticket.model_ticket_contract import ModelTicketContract
from omnibase_core.models.pipeline.model_golden_chain_entry import ModelGoldenChainEntry
from omnimarket.nodes.node_golden_chain_generator_compute.models.model_golden_chain_generation_request import (
    ModelGoldenChainGenerationRequest,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_golden_chain_generator_compute.models.model_golden_chain_generation_result import (
    EnumGoldenChainGenerationStatus,
)


def _make_contract(
    ticket_id="T-1",
    golden_path=None,
    contract_fingerprint="fp-1",
):
    return ModelTicketContract(
        ticket_id=ticket_id,
        golden_path=golden_path,
        contract_fingerprint=contract_fingerprint,
    )


def _make_request(contract, generator_version="1.0", template_hash="th", generated_test_hash="gth"):
    return ModelGoldenChainGenerationRequest(
        contract=contract,
        generator_version=generator_version,
        template_hash=template_hash,
        generated_test_hash=generated_test_hash,
    )


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_handle_no_golden_path_returns_insufficient():
    contract = _make_contract(golden_path=None)
    req = _make_request(contract)
    handler = HandlerGoldenChainGenerator()
    result = handler.handle(req)

    assert result.status == EnumGoldenChainGenerationStatus.INSUFFICIENT_CONTRACT
    assert result.ticket_id == "T-1"
    assert result.expected_chain == ()
    assert len(result.deferred_warnings) == 1
    assert result.deferred_warnings[0].code == "GOLDEN_PATH_MISSING"
    assert result.generator_version == "1.0"
    assert result.template_hash == "th"
    assert result.generated_test_hash == "gth"
    assert result.contract_fingerprint == "fp-1"


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_handle_with_golden_path_no_assertions_returns_deferred():
    from omnibase_core.models.ticket.model_ticket_contract import ModelGoldenPath, ModelGoldenPathInput, ModelGoldenPathOutput
    gp = ModelGoldenPath(
        input=ModelGoldenPathInput(topic="in-topic"),
        output=ModelGoldenPathOutput(topic="out-topic"),
    )
    contract = _make_contract(golden_path=gp)
    req = _make_request(contract)
    handler = HandlerGoldenChainGenerator()
    result = handler.handle(req)

    assert result.expected_chain[0].topic == "in-topic"
    assert result.expected_chain[1].event_type == "golden_path_output"
    assert result.expected_chain[1].topic == "out-topic"
    assert len(result.deferred_warnings) == 2
    assert result.deferred_warnings[0].code == "SOURCE_NODE_UNKNOWN"
    assert result.deferred_warnings[1].code == "SOURCE_NODE_UNKNOWN"
